audit.why: Taliyah-favored in every phase per packet and content: she out-ranges, out-clears and out-roams a dashless TF; his threat is the gold card and Destiny map pressure, not the lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart carried blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows; content win[] and packet both say Taliyah on all seven.
audit.why: Content whys are kit-grounded (no dash, worse waveclear, Destiny is a roam threat not a lane threat). Full sides moved to Taliyah with rewritten whys and ratings.
audit.corrected: All seven full sides set to Taliyah.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digits; the Pick a Card auto-reset burst tell (missing-interactions rule) was unstated; two pasted trade strings under Do's/Don'ts titles.
audit.why: Pick a Card is a 6s cooldown auto-reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is the cue to step back. Destiny runs 170/140/110s. TF has no dash, so Taliyah's W-E root is inescapable and Q's move-while-casting beats his stationary aim.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with digits and the auto-reset tell; bleed bullets rewritten to match their titles.

edits.before: Twisted Fate wins by landing Pick a Card (Gold), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Twisted Fate wins by landing the gold-card stun into Wild Cards, and by cashing Destiny roams while you push a dead lane.

edits.before: Q on fresh ground shreds level-1 trades — most mids don't expect five stones at minute two. Manage your Worked Ground like mana.
edits.after: Q on fresh ground outranges Wild Cards in practice — sidestep his only poke on terrain and chunk him at every last-hit.

edits.before: W online: the shove-displacement already threatens kill angles against overstep-happy laners.
edits.after: W online: he has no dash — the shove into a root threat already wins level-2 exchanges.

edits.before: Full kit: W-into-E is the signature burst — shove him across the stones and watch half a health bar disappear.
edits.after: Full kit: W into worked-ground E roots him — no dash means no escape, so punish every step into Wild Cards range.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: You shove faster than his blue card clears — control the wave through 4-5 and poke him off every pinned last-hit.

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: Destiny is a roam threat, not a lane threat — shove with Q and match his 170s global with your own Weaver's Wall.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes squishies. Force river fights where your stones pre-seed the geometry.
edits.after: Lost Chapter lets you perma-freeze a dashless, clear-starved champion under tower — every crash buys plates or roams.

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Late you out-fight him: E zoning and Wall picks beat a gold-card stun — delete him before Pick a Card lands and he's nothing.

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Seismic Shove for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Pick a Card (6s): the locked gold card starts every trade — his W is an auto-reset, so the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step back. - Destiny runs 170/140/110s; while it's down his roam threat is a bluff. - Your W (14s) covers emergencies, R covers chances.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: Seed Q stones across the middle of the lane before trades — worked-ground boulders slow him, and a slowed, dashless TF never escapes your W-E root.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: Your Q lets you move while casting — use it; a stationary Taliyah is the only target his gold-card burst reliably hits.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP feeds the roam plan and matches his Destiny tempo bot; Ignite converts the W-E root into kills. Pick by intent.
